message.content:
I’m not able to pull live exchange‑rate data directly, but as of the most recent rates (mid‑2024) 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that approximation:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;\text{GBP/USD} \;\approx\; £15.6
\]

So roughly **£15.60**.  

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so you’ll want to check a reliable financial source or your bank’s current rate for the exact amount at the time of your transaction.
